confidence_notes: Food, coffee and beer estimates use a June 2026 [Numbeo snapshot](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/San-Antonio). [Square's local bar prices](https://squareup.com/us/en/menu-pricing/bar-prices-in-san-antonio) inform the cocktail estimate; wine is estimated relative to beer and [local happy-hour prices](https://hhatlas.com/happy-hour-index/san-antonio/). Accommodation is modeled, with limited hostel supply and date variation adding uncertainty. Estimates exclude tax and tips.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use the broader mid-priced Texas and southern US visitor market, adjusted for San Antonio's tourism demand.
